question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab states that younger clients learn about finances primarily through social media and family, and their top online resource is YouTube.
items.quote: We know they learn about finances primarily through social media and family. ... Their top online resource is YouTube, and we're the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers.

items.text: Schwab states that one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under the age of 40, showing younger investors are engaged in building wealth over the long term.
items.quote: And younger investors at Schwab are highly engaged in building their wealth over the long term. In fact, one-third of retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years are under the age of 40.
items.unit: retail households who created a financial plan within the last two years under age 40

items.text: Schwab states that younger traders turn to Schwab because they recognize the potential that trading has in helping build wealth over time, and for the platforms, tools, education, coaching, expertise, and service to help them succeed.
items.quote: Younger traders are turning to us because they recognize the potential that trading has in helping build wealth over time. And they are turning to Schwab because we have the platforms, tools, education, coaching, expertise, and service they need to help them succeed.

items.text: Schwab states that younger investors are attracted through its trading platform thinkorswim, digital capabilities, support, service, and education including 35 hours a week of live content on how to trade and invest.
items.quote: I think what we can offer the young investor in terms of the support, the service, the education, and of course, the leading platform with thinkorswim and our digital capabilities, I think is unmatched.

items.text: Schwab states that it is meeting younger investors in the channels where they turn for information about investing.
items.quote: One of the reasons they're turning to Schwab is because we're meeting them in the channels where they turn for information about investing.

items.text: Schwab states that younger investors are engaged with trading, with growth in comfort with options trading as a way to add income or hedge portfolios, and use of AI for research and trading.
items.quote: We've also seen growth and comfort with options trading as people are becoming more familiar with that as a way to add income or hedge portfolios. ... I think AI is absolutely benefactor in our trading levels and will continue to drive trading as people use AI to both do research on how to position themselves and how to invest.

items.text: Schwab states that the removal of commissions brought more people with less money into the market, including young investors.
items.quote: We've really seen a growth in young investors, I think part of that was started with the removal of commissions, which brought more people into the market that had less money.

items.text: Schwab states that crypto will certainly appeal to young investors.
items.quote: Crypto will be great for clients and will certainly appeal to young investors.

items.text: Schwab states that its client engagement preferences span digital-first to relationship-led, and its investing styles span self-directed to advised.
items.quote: Investing Styles Self-directed to advised 3 / Digital-first to relationship-led Engagement Preferences 4

items.text: Schwab states that younger investors are offered the Schwab Starter Kit, Schwab Teen Investor Account, and no/low commissions.
items.quote: Younger investors | Schwab Starter Kit TM | Schwab Teen Investor TM Account | No / low commissions

items.text: Schwab states that 42% of thinkorswim users are Millennial or Gen Z, showing younger investors' product use and engagement with the trading platform.
items.quote: 42% of thinkorswim→ users are Millennial or Gen Z 1
items.unit: thinkorswim users who are Millennial or Gen Z

items.text: Schwab states that young investors want to think about how to pay off their college debt and how to buy a house.
items.quote: young investors who want to think about how to pay off their college debt, how to buy a house, there's no better place to be than here at Schwab.

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe younger investors' and clients under 40 preferences, including channels (social media/YouTube), products (trading platform, crypto, starter kit, teen account), and engagement (education, planning, digital-first).
